title: Minor cuts and scrapes
scenario: Small cut, scrape, or graze — from broken glass or debris. Bleeding is light and stops with pressure.
steps: Wash your hands first if you can.
Rinse the cut under clean running water to remove dirt.
Press gently with a clean cloth until bleeding stops — usually a few minutes.
Cover with an adhesive bandage or clean dressing.
Change the covering daily or when wet or dirty.
Watch for infection over the next days: spreading redness, warmth, swelling, or pus. If these appear, or the wound was deep and dirty, seek medical care — a tetanus booster may be needed.
do_not: Do not use dirty water on an open wound.
Do not ignore deep punctures — they need medical attention even if small.
